originalText: আমাদের গ্রামে গত দুই সপ্তাহ ধরে কোনো পানীয় জল নেই এবং টিউবওয়েলটি ভেঙে গেছে।
translatedText: There has been no drinking water in our village for the past two weeks and the tubewell is broken.
summary: Broken community tubewell causing acute drinking water shortage for two weeks.
recommendation: Dispatch municipal PHE repair team to restore community tubewell immediately.

originalText: Ponte de madeira que liga os produtores de leite à cidade caiu após fortes chuvas.
translatedText: Wooden bridge connecting dairy producers to the city collapsed after heavy rains.
summary: Collapsed wooden bridge isolates dairy farmers from urban market following heavy rainfall.
recommendation: Allocate rural infrastructure contingency fund for modular steel bridge installation.

originalText: Clinic has frequent power blackouts; refrigerated vaccines are spoiling.
translatedText: Clinic has frequent power blackouts; refrigerated vaccines are spoiling.
summary: Recurring power outages at community clinic leading to spoilage of critical vaccines.
recommendation: Fast-track priority hybrid solar-battery microgrid installation for the clinic.

originalText: बाढ़ के कारण मुख्य संपर्क मार्ग टूट गया है और कोई नाव उपलब्ध नहीं है।
translatedText: The main connecting road has broken due to floods and no boats are available.
summary: Flood damage to primary transit route leaving community stranded without boat transport.
recommendation: Deploy state disaster response rescue boats and initiate emergency culvert repair.
